# Best consultancies for workflow automation in Hobart

If you're looking to automate business processes using Microsoft Power Automate, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, or Power Apps, I'd start with a shortlist that separates **dedicated Power Platform specialists** from local IT consultancies and broader process-improvement firms.

The strongest fit depends on whether you need straightforward approval flows and repetitive admin automated, or a more substantial solution connecting multiple business systems.

## My shortlist

![Serviced Offices in Hobart | Reserve Bank Building](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/OdZoNh5dOZyDd8ZQIqko-nxTF7f7HJdW5rCmz8m_pBQzH2bh7kZVPF95UcfrOiuh6cGrDWDocaHk1NQP_Dhg9bh4jo7XmjSf1LOEjrdjOpYHS1B8c_QLA7F3bnR8idEDg3Qwg0115mHy9t-dh6vpUDTJrDT1CW87IU32C-qszWQnkq_EgXeQbNPzvDycXa7w?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Cyberhaven Technologies

(Best direct automation match)

Hobart CBD · Level 1, 153 Macquarie Street

Cyberhaven explicitly advertises Microsoft Power Automate alongside robotic process automation (RPA), API integration and custom automation development. Its published process covers discovery, solution design, testing, deployment, training and support. [cyberhaven.com.au](https://cyberhaven.com.au/our-services/system-automation-services-in-hobart/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Invoice processing, data entry, onboarding, compliance reporting and workflows spanning several systems.

\+61 3 6164 8899

[Website and automation services](https://cyberhaven.com.au/our-services/system-automation-services-in-hobart/)

## 2\. Intuit Technologies

Hobart · Battery Point

A strong candidate if automation is part of a wider Microsoft cloud or business-systems project. Its listed capabilities include Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 and Power Platform, including Power Automate. **Best for\:** Integrating automation with your Microsoft environment, improving collaboration and adding broader IT support.

\+61 3 6281 5600

[Intuit Technologies website](https://www.intuit.com.au/)

---

## 3\. ISW

Battery Point, Hobart

Its broader engineering offering makes it worth considering for more involved implementations. **Best for\:** SharePoint and Teams integration, custom business applications, and larger Microsoft platform projects.

## 4\. Tasprint

219 Murray Street, Hobart

Tasprint specialises in document and digital workflow transformation, including accounts payable invoice processing and employee management. It also offers project management, change management and ongoing support. [www.tasprint.com.au](https://www.tasprint.com.au/services/digital-transformation-and-automation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 5\. Element Digital

Tasmanian-based IT consultancy

Element Digital focuses on Microsoft 365, Azure, infrastructure and automation, with a delivery approach that includes design, implementation, documentation, training and handover. [elementdigital.com.au](https://elementdigital.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Organisations that need automation alongside Microsoft 365 configuration, security and infrastructure improvements.

1300 966 576

[Element Digital website](https://elementdigital.com.au/)

## Other consultancies worth considering

These are useful alternatives if your priority is broader workflow improvement or connecting disparate systems, rather than Power Automate alone.

- **[ByteX](https://www.bytex.com.au/)** — Tasmania-based, founder-led consultancy working across business operations, Microsoft cloud services, automation, APIs, databases and system integration. Particularly relevant for small businesses with disconnected software. [www.bytex.com.au](https://www.bytex.com.au/about?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **[Buftec](https://www.buftec.com/)** — Hobart-based systems consultancy specialising in business applications, integrations, databases and operational automation. Worth considering when the workflow crosses legacy systems or requires custom technical work. [www.buftec.com](https://www.buftec.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## How I would choose

| Your main requirement | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| Power Automate and cross-system automation | Cyberhaven Technologies |
| Microsoft 365 and broader IT integration | Intuit Technologies |
| Larger Microsoft platform or custom application project | ISW |
| Documents, invoices and paper-heavy processes | Tasprint |
| Microsoft cloud, security and infrastructure alongside automation | Element Digital |


These are **best-fit recommendations based on published capabilities**, not a verified ranking of customer satisfaction or project outcomes. I would confirm each firm's current Power Automate delivery experience, relevant case studies and availability before selecting one.

## Questions to ask before engaging

1. Can you show me two or three Power Automate implementations similar to my workflow?
2. Will you use standard Power Automate connectors where possible, and explain any premium licensing or custom integration costs?
3. Will the flows be built in my organisation's Microsoft tenant, with appropriate service accounts, security and error alerts?
4. Will I receive documentation, training and the ability to maintain the automations internally?
5. Can we start with one small, fixed-scope pilot before committing to a larger program?

A good consultancy should also explain when Power Automate is not the right solution, rather than automatically building everything on one platform.

---

**One question to narrow this down\:** What kind of business workflow are you primarily trying to automate?

Main automation requirement

Approvals, email, forms, SharePoint and Teams

Invoices, finance, PDFs and document processing

Connecting CRM, ERP, databases or other software

Reviewing and automating entire business processes

---

Organisation size

Small to medium business

Mid-sized or enterprise organisation

Government or not-for-profit

---

Provider preference

Prefer a Hobart-based provider

Open to Australian-wide remote specialists
